resource_metadata.name: Historic Demand Data 2026
resource_metadata.description:
Historic electricity demand, interconnector, wind and solar outturn data for 2026. Please find a brief summary of some of the columns in the dataset:

ND = National Demand is the sum of metered generation, but excludes generation required to meet station load, hydro storage pumping and interconnector exports

TSD = Transmission System Demand is equal to the ND plus the additional generation required to meet station load, pump storage pumping and interconnector exports. **NOTE:** NESO have moved the data source to its new forecast system. We are aware of an issue with missing Scottish transfer data and are looking into a prompt resolution.
